title: SavantMotionFingerprintRow
description: One append-only registry row describing a completed motion build. A new build must score a weighted Hamming distance of at least 5 of a possible 8 against EVERY existing row (grammar weight 2, signatureMove weight 2, nav/hero/actShape/close weight 1).

nav.description: Navigation treatment, e.g. 'fixed minimal bar', 'waypoint map', 'none'.

hero.description: Hero device, e.g. 'full-bleed scrub', 'title page, no media'.

actShape.description: Act sequence shape, e.g. 'scrub > pin > flow > pan, 6 acts, ~13vh'.

close.description: Close pattern, e.g. 'pinned spotlight CTA', 'running-text colophon'.

signatureMove.description: The bespoke interaction unique to this build. Never reused across rows.

summary.description: Optional one-line world/palette note for future planning context.

overriddenBy.description: Present only when the operator approved a collision via --allow-collision.
